notify.sourceNotLoaded: That chat card isn't loaded in the log. Scroll up to load older messages.

error.notAllowed: Damage Log | You aren't allowed to {verb} this {what}.
error.actorMissing: Damage Log | That actor no longer exists.
error.noWriter: Damage Log | Can't {verb} {what}: neither {user} nor a GM is connected.

allowPlayerView.name: Allow players to view the damage log
allowPlayerView.hint: Players see entries for actors they have the minimum permission below on.

minPlayerPermission.name: Minimum actor permission
minPlayerPermission.hint: Players see an actor's HP table only if they have this permission (or better) on it.

allowPlayerUndo.name: Allow players to undo/redo damage
allowPlayerUndo.hint: Players can undo and redo damage and healing on actors they own.

showLimitedInfo.name: Show limited damage info to players
showLimitedInfo.hint: Every player sees how much damage or healing every actor took, but not the Old/Change/New table.

hideHealingInLimitedInfo.name: Hide healing in the limited damage info
hideHealingInLimitedInfo.hint: Healing isn't shown in the limited info; only players who can see the table see it.

gmOnlyHiddenTokens.name: Hidden tokens are GM-only
gmOnlyHiddenTokens.hint: Damage and healing on a token hidden from players is shown to GMs only. Use Reveal on the message to show it later.

clampToMax.name: Clamp to max HP
clampToMax.hint: When undoing damage or redoing healing, don't take HP above the actor's current maximum.

clampToMin.name: Clamp to min HP
clampToMin.hint: When redoing damage or undoing healing, don't take HP or temp HP below 0.

suppressNotify.name: Quiet entries
suppressNotify.hint: Entries don't flash the chat tab, pop up a notification or play a sound.

ignoreRests.name: Don't log rests
ignoreRests.hint: HP recovered on a short or long rest, including hit dice spent, isn't logged.

showDamageTypes.name: Show damage types
showDamageTypes.hint: List the damage types, resistances and the attack an HP change came from, when dnd5e applied it.

debugLogging.name: Debug logging
debugLogging.hint: Write what the damage log does to the browser console. For troubleshooting.
